glosses: Thinking about unpleasant things that have happened or that might happen; feeling afraid and unhappy.

examples.text: She was worried about her son who had been sent off to fight in the war.

Having a feeling of anxiety or disquietude; extremely concerned, especially about something that will happen in the future or that is unknown.

examples.text: She was anxious to hear how her test results were.
I could tell she was anxious as she was biting her nails.

examples.text: I was preoccupied with a deadline at work, and I forgot his birthday.
